panels.description: Indoor and target temperature from the thermostat (every 2-minute reading, averaged per Grafana interval when the range is long) and outdoor temperature from the weather (hourly; live readings are preferred over the archive). The dashed outdoor forecast line continues from the latest outdoor reading with the forecast daily mean temperature (drawn at midday); a forecast day disappears as real readings cover it. The gap between indoor and target is the demand for heat. The target holds until changed, so it is drawn as a step.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(polled_at, $__interval),
  AVG(current_temp) AS indoor,
  CAST(
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(target_temp ORDER BY polled_at), ',', -1)
    AS DECIMAL(5, 2)
  ) AS target
FROM heating_status
WHERE $__timeFilter(polled_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  observed_at AS time,
  temp AS outdoor
FROM (
  SELECT
    w.observed_at,
    w.temp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY w.observed_at
      ORDER BY (COALESCE(w.source, '') = 'open-meteo-archive'), w.id
    ) AS preference
  FROM weather_observation w
  WHERE $__timeFilter(w.observed_at)
    AND w.temp IS NOT NULL
    AND w.location = (
      SELECT l.location FROM weather_observation l
      ORDER BY l.observed_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT 1
    )
) ranked
WHERE preference = 1
ORDER BY observed_at;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT w.observed_at, w.temp
  FROM weather_observation w
  WHERE w.temp IS NOT NULL
    AND w.location = (
      SELECT l.location FROM weather_observation l
      ORDER BY l.observed_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT 1
    )
  ORDER BY w.observed_at DESC, (COALESCE(w.source, '') = 'open-meteo-archive'), w.id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT time, outdoor_forecast
FROM (
  SELECT observed_at AS time, temp AS outdoor_forecast
  FROM latest

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(f.target_date AS DATETIME) + INTERVAL 12 HOUR, '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    f.mean_temp AS outdoor_forecast
  FROM weather_forecast f
  CROSS JOIN latest
  WHERE f.mean_temp IS NOT NULL
    AND f.target_date >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 'UTC', '${timezone}'))
    AND f.id = (
      SELECT f2.id FROM weather_forecast f2
      WHERE f2.target_date = f.target_date AND f2.mean_temp IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY f2.fetched_at DESC, f2.id DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    AND CONVERT_TZ(CAST(f.target_date AS DATETIME) + INTERVAL 12 HOUR, '${timezone}', 'UTC') > latest.observed_at
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Indoor, Target and Outdoor Temperature

panels.description: Daily gas as bars, in kWh or pounds (the Daily gas unit switch at the top). Pounds are split into the unit cost (kWh x the unit rate) and the standing charge. Days without a complete gas figure are gaps, never zeros. The lighter bars are the heating model's estimated gas for today and the next days (none when there is no usable model); in pounds they use the unit rate and standing charge in force on the day, so a rate change inside the week is not foreseen. The line is the daily mean outdoor temperature for complete London days (right axis).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, gas_kwh
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(s.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    s.total_kwh AS gas_kwh
  FROM daily_consumption_summary s
  WHERE ${gas_unit:sqlstring} = 'kWh'
    AND s.energy = 'G'
    AND s.total_kwh > 0
    AND (
      s.half_hour_count IS NULL
      OR s.half_hour_count = TIMESTAMPDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        CONVERT_TZ(CAST(s.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC'),
        CONVERT_TZ(CAST(s.date + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC')
      ) / 30
    )
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT time, unit_cost_gbp, standing_charge_gbp
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(s.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    ROUND(s.total_kwh * pr.unit_rate / 100, 4) AS unit_cost_gbp,
    ROUND(pr.standing_charge / 100, 4) AS standing_charge_gbp
  FROM daily_consumption_summary s
  JOIN agreement a
    ON a.energy = 'G'
   AND CONVERT_TZ(CAST(s.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') >= a.valid_from
   AND CONVERT_TZ(CAST(s.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') < COALESCE(a.valid_to, '9999-12-31 23:59:59')
  JOIN product_rate pr
    ON pr.id = (
      SELECT pr2.id FROM product_rate pr2
      WHERE pr2.product_code = a.product_code
        AND pr2.region = ${region:sqlstring}
        AND pr2.valid_from <= CONVERT_TZ(CAST(s.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC')
      ORDER BY pr2.valid_from DESC
      LIMIT 1
    )
  WHERE ${gas_unit:sqlstring} = 'pounds'
    AND s.energy = 'G'
    AND s.total_kwh > 0
    AND (
      s.half_hour_count IS NULL
      OR s.half_hour_count = TIMESTAMPDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        CONVERT_TZ(CAST(s.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC'),
        CONVERT_TZ(CAST(s.date + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC')
      ) / 30
    )
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

WITH wx AS (
  SELECT observed_at, temp
  FROM (
    SELECT
      w.observed_at, w.temp,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY w.observed_at
        ORDER BY (COALESCE(w.source, '') = 'open-meteo-archive'), w.id
      ) AS preference
    FROM weather_observation w
    WHERE w.temp IS NOT NULL
      AND w.observed_at >= $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
      AND w.observed_at <= $__timeTo() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND w.location = (
        SELECT l.location FROM weather_observation l
        ORDER BY l.observed_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT 1
      )
  ) ranked
  WHERE preference = 1
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(CONVERT_TZ(observed_at, 'UTC', '${timezone}')) AS day,
    AVG(temp) AS mean_temp,
    MIN(temp) AS min_temp,
    MAX(temp) AS max_temp
  FROM wx
  GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(observed_at, 'UTC', '${timezone}'))
  HAVING COUNT(*) = TIMESTAMPDIFF(
    HOUR,
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(day AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC'),
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(day + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC')
  )
)
SELECT time, outdoor_mean
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(day AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    ROUND(mean_temp, 1) AS outdoor_mean
  FROM daily
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT time, expected_kwh
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(f.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    ROUND(f.expected_gas, 3) AS expected_kwh
  FROM heating_forecast_day f
  WHERE ${gas_unit:sqlstring} = 'kWh'
    AND f.model_id = (SELECT m.id FROM heating_model m WHERE m.usable = 1 ORDER BY m.fitted_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1)
    AND f.date >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 'UTC', '${timezone}'))
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT time, expected_unit_cost_gbp, expected_standing_charge_gbp
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(f.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    ROUND(f.expected_gas * pr.unit_rate / 100, 4) AS expected_unit_cost_gbp,
    ROUND(pr.standing_charge / 100, 4) AS expected_standing_charge_gbp
  FROM heating_forecast_day f
  JOIN agreement a
    ON a.energy = 'G'
   AND CONVERT_TZ(CAST(f.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') >= a.valid_from
   AND CONVERT_TZ(CAST(f.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') < COALESCE(a.valid_to, '9999-12-31 23:59:59')
  JOIN product_rate pr
    ON pr.id = (
      SELECT pr2.id FROM product_rate pr2
      WHERE pr2.product_code = a.product_code
        AND pr2.region = ${region:sqlstring}
        AND pr2.valid_from <= CONVERT_TZ(CAST(f.date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC')
      ORDER BY pr2.valid_from DESC
      LIMIT 1
    )
  WHERE ${gas_unit:sqlstring} = 'pounds'
    AND f.model_id = (SELECT m.id FROM heating_model m WHERE m.usable = 1 ORDER BY m.fitted_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1)
    AND f.date >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 'UTC', '${timezone}'))
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Daily Gas and Outdoor Temperature (${gas_unit})

panels.description: Gas cost of the heating in each completed hour, at that hour's gas unit rate (no standing charge). Heating is any hour the thermostat called for heat or a boost was on. 'Measured' hours use Octopus's half-hourly gas less a learned hot-water baseline; 'estimated' hours (the newest ~1.5 days, until the gas arrives) use the minutes on times the boiler's learned kW. An hour with too many missing Hive readings is left blank, not shown as zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, measured_cost_gbp, estimated_cost_gbp
FROM (
  SELECT
    h.hour_start AS time,
    IF(h.source = 'measured', ROUND(h.cost_gbp, 4), NULL) AS measured_cost_gbp,
    IF(h.source = 'estimated', ROUND(h.cost_gbp, 4), NULL) AS estimated_cost_gbp
  FROM heating_hour h
  WHERE $__timeFilter(h.hour_start)
    AND h.on_minutes > 0
    AND h.cost_gbp IS NOT NULL
) d
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Heating Cost per Hour

panels.description: Minutes per day (readings x the 2-minute poll interval) with a comfort target active (target at or above the Comfort target setting) and the room more than the Margin below it. A day on the frost setting counts zero whatever the temperature.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, minutes_below_target
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(day AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    minutes_below_target
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE(CONVERT_TZ(polled_at, 'UTC', '${timezone}')) AS day,
      IF(
        IF(${comfort_target:sqlstring} REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$', CAST(${comfort_target:sqlstring} AS DECIMAL(8, 2)), NULL) IS NULL OR IF(${comfort_margin:sqlstring} REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$', CAST(${comfort_margin:sqlstring} AS DECIMAL(8, 2)), NULL) IS NULL,
        NULL,
        COUNT(CASE
          WHEN target_temp >= IF(${comfort_target:sqlstring} REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$', CAST(${comfort_target:sqlstring} AS DECIMAL(8, 2)), NULL)
           AND current_temp < target_temp - IF(${comfort_margin:sqlstring} REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$', CAST(${comfort_margin:sqlstring} AS DECIMAL(8, 2)), NULL)
          THEN 1 END) * 2
      ) AS minutes_below_target
    FROM heating_status
    WHERE polled_at >= $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
      AND polled_at <= $__timeTo()
    GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(polled_at, 'UTC', '${timezone}'))
  ) b
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Minutes Below Target (comfort target ${comfort_target} C, margin ${comfort_margin} C)

panels.description: Daily minimum and maximum outdoor temperature (shaded between them) for complete London days, with the indoor average over waking hours: the average room temperature between the Wake Up and Bedtime hours (London time), drawn only for days with at least 80% of the expected thermostat polls in that window. Live outdoor readings are preferred over the archive. The dotted lines continue the minimum and maximum as forecasts from today onward.

targets.rawSql:
WITH wx AS (
  SELECT observed_at, temp
  FROM (
    SELECT
      w.observed_at, w.temp,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY w.observed_at
        ORDER BY (COALESCE(w.source, '') = 'open-meteo-archive'), w.id
      ) AS preference
    FROM weather_observation w
    WHERE w.temp IS NOT NULL
      AND w.observed_at >= $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
      AND w.observed_at <= $__timeTo() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND w.location = (
        SELECT l.location FROM weather_observation l
        ORDER BY l.observed_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT 1
      )
  ) ranked
  WHERE preference = 1
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(CONVERT_TZ(observed_at, 'UTC', '${timezone}')) AS day,
    MIN(temp) AS min_temp,
    MAX(temp) AS max_temp
  FROM wx
  GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(observed_at, 'UTC', '${timezone}'))
  HAVING COUNT(*) = TIMESTAMPDIFF(
    HOUR,
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(day AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC'),
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(day + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC')
  )
),
waking AS (
  SELECT IF(b > w, w, NULL) AS wake_up, IF(b > w, b, NULL) AS bedtime
  FROM (
    SELECT
      IF(${wake_up:sqlstring} REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,2}$' AND CAST(${wake_up:sqlstring} AS SIGNED) <= 23, CAST(${wake_up:sqlstring} AS SIGNED), NULL) AS w,
      IF(${bedtime:sqlstring} REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,2}$' AND CAST(${bedtime:sqlstring} AS SIGNED) <= 23, CAST(${bedtime:sqlstring} AS SIGNED), NULL) AS b
  ) r
),
indoor AS (
  SELECT DATE(h.local_at) AS day, AVG(h.current_temp) AS indoor_avg
  FROM (
    SELECT CONVERT_TZ(polled_at, 'UTC', '${timezone}') AS local_at, current_temp
    FROM heating_status
    WHERE current_temp IS NOT NULL
      AND polled_at >= $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
      AND polled_at <= $__timeTo() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  ) h
  CROSS JOIN waking p
  WHERE HOUR(h.local_at) >= p.wake_up AND HOUR(h.local_at) < p.bedtime
  GROUP BY DATE(h.local_at), p.wake_up, p.bedtime
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 0.8 * (p.bedtime - p.wake_up) * 30
),
days AS (
  SELECT day FROM daily
  UNION
  SELECT day FROM indoor
)
SELECT time, min_temp, max_temp, indoor_avg
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(days.day AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    ROUND(daily.min_temp, 1) AS min_temp,
    ROUND(daily.max_temp, 1) AS max_temp,
    ROUND(indoor.indoor_avg, 1) AS indoor_avg
  FROM days
  LEFT JOIN daily ON daily.day = days.day
  LEFT JOIN indoor ON indoor.day = days.day
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT time, forecast_min
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(f.target_date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    ROUND(f.min_temp, 1) AS forecast_min
  FROM weather_forecast f
  WHERE f.min_temp IS NOT NULL
    AND f.target_date >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 'UTC', '${timezone}'))
    AND f.id = (
      SELECT f2.id FROM weather_forecast f2
      WHERE f2.target_date = f.target_date AND f2.min_temp IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY f2.fetched_at DESC, f2.id DESC LIMIT 1
    )
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT time, forecast_max
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(CAST(f.target_date AS DATETIME), '${timezone}', 'UTC') AS time,
    ROUND(f.max_temp, 1) AS forecast_max
  FROM weather_forecast f
  WHERE f.max_temp IS NOT NULL
    AND f.target_date >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 'UTC', '${timezone}'))
    AND f.id = (
      SELECT f2.id FROM weather_forecast f2
      WHERE f2.target_date = f.target_date AND f2.max_temp IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY f2.fetched_at DESC, f2.id DESC LIMIT 1
    )
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Daily Outdoor Temperature Band

targets.rawSql:
SELECT actual_cost_to_date AS billing_period_cost_gbp, projected_total_cost AS projected_cost_gbp
FROM cost_forecast
WHERE energy = 'G'
ORDER BY computed_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Gas Billing Period Progress ($gas_billing_period_start → $gas_billing_period_end)${gas_rates_estimated_note}
panels.description: The latest gas row of the cost forecast: cost so far against the projected total for the billing period. It shows whatever the cost forecast currently computes (since the heating model was adopted, each remaining day's expected gas comes from the model).

list.description: IANA timezone that defines a local day; must match the apps' timezone setting.
list.label: Timezone
list.name: timezone

list.description: Whether the Daily Gas panel shows kWh or pounds (in pounds: unit cost and, where it applies, standing charge).
list.label: Daily gas unit
list.name: gas_unit

list.description: A target at or above this counts as a comfort target; below it is the frost setting. Digits only (no spaces or units); anything else shows no data.
list.label: Comfort target (C)
list.name: comfort_target

list.description: How far below its target the room must be for a minute to count. Digits only (no spaces or units); anything else shows no data.
list.label: Margin below target (C)

list.description: The hour you get up, in whole hours 0-23 (London time). Digits only (no spaces or units); anything else shows no data.

list.description: The hour you go to bed, in whole hours 0-23 (London time), after Wake Up. Digits only (no spaces or units); anything else shows no data.
